311"Part 1"
"My Log Has a Message for You"		David LynchMark Frost & David LynchMay 21, 2017 (2017-05-21)0.506[1]
In 2014, 25 years after the events of the previous season, FBI agent Dale Cooper remains trapped in the Black Lodge. The Fireman (formerly The Giant) tells him to remember "430" and "Richard and Linda".
322"Part 2"
"The Stars Turn and a Time Presents Itself"		David LynchMark Frost & David LynchMay 21, 2017 (2017-05-21)0.506[1]
Bill Hastings's wife visits him in jail and is later murdered in her home by Cooper's doppelgänger, so she will not implicate him in the murder that she hired him to commit, to frame Bill for his infidelity. In Las Vegas, businessman Duncan Todd sends money to an unseen woman for a future job.
333"Part 3"
"Call for Help"		David LynchMark Frost & David LynchMay 28, 2017 (2017-05-28)[a]0.195[3]
Cooper lands in a building above a purple-colored sea, where he is protected from an unseen threat by two women, one of them eyeless. The eyeless woman, Naido, pulls a lever and falls into space.
